visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, messy hair and a white t-shirt under a greyish jacket holds a phone for a selfie video inside a red rickshaw. He smiles widely at the camera, looking around the vehicle's interior which features a red padded ceiling with a circular logo. (2) The scene cuts to a view of a Jaipur street. A police officer in a light blue uniform stands near motorcycles, talking into a handheld radio. Terracotta-colored buildings with intricate white floral patterns line the background under a bright, clear sky. (3) Back to the man in the rickshaw, he continues talking with animated facial expressions, eyes widening as he glances at the traffic outside. He points slightly with his hand as he describes the scene. (4) Multiple quick cuts show the chaotic flow of traffic: green and yellow auto-rickshaws, motorbikes, and pedestrians navigate an intersection without apparent regard for traffic lights. (5) A purple-clad woman walks past the moving rickshaw. The camera pans slightly to show more of the city's pink architecture and bustling street life. (6) The man looks directly into the lens, his expression turning slightly more serious but still intrigued, followed by a transition to a black screen with white bold text.
